_comment: Advisories that `npm run audit:check` tolerates. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry date; once expired it fails CI again and must be re-reviewed. Only list advisories with no non-breaking fix.

GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4.reason: No patched release (latest is 4.3.1). Dev-only, via jest -> jest-config; it only merges jest's own config objects, never untrusted input. The audit's suggested fix is a downgrade to jest 25.

GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4.reason: Dev-only, via jest -> @jest/reporters / test-exclude. The flaw is an AbortSignal bypass in glob's async API; jest only globs its own project files and never passes an AbortSignal. The fix needs glob >14.0.1, which jest 30 does not accept; the audit's suggested fix is a downgrade to jest 25.

GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249.reason: Dev-only, via jest -> test-exclude and nodemon. Denial of service needs a crafted glob pattern; patterns here come from local jest/nodemon config, never untrusted input. The fix needs minimatch >=11.0.1, outside the ranges jest 30 and nodemon 3 depend on; the audit's suggested fix is a downgrade to jest 25.
